Lines.en: Are the storms getting weaker?
Alert! Hologram-shields block off Infernoes' Tornados.
Hologram-shields block off Infernoes' Tornados.
Storms always pull zombies close towards my door.
But not today.
Time to keep them away with storms!
Wasabi Whips lash out with their flaming whips, delivering whippings to zombies both in front and behind.
We had to keep some space for Pepper-pults when frozen wind came over.
That just always made my lawn messy.
Check out the new plant. It's on sale.
Pyre Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide protection from cold.
I'd like a piece of ice to snack on from those ice sculptures.
It's getting hot in here.
Those arn not ice sculptures, but frozen zombies.
Still, I'm melting.
Speaking of mirrors, ...
...how could we have ignored the light?
Couldn't agree more, User Dave!
Mirror-nuts and Infi-nuts make good teams.
What a shiny Disco...
...Nut
Mirror-nuts collects energies from other nuts when they're damaged.
Click to release the energies.
Pea Commandoes deploy flying pea soldiers against zombie.
Wait, are you talking about ...
... aircraft carriers?
To be precise...
... they are flying aircraft carriers.
Aerial-aircraft carrier！
Is there a chance that we let plants that are wing-less be planted in the sky?
Like how we planted them on Lily Pads.
Easy. Just flying flowerpots are what we needed.
Easier than lifting the ground after all.
Flowerpot? What plant is that?
A button?
What if we push it?
Seems like it triggers a missile silo somewhere.
Enter "35711, 131719". Then push the button.
Wait, did we just blow something up?
The big w-ake sh-oke me up. What just happened, Penny?
Our experiments on controllable turbulence just came to a new period!
Loquanadoes create strong turbulences, ...
which gather nearby zombies.
Excellent! That just ruined my nightmare.
Sounds like ... good news?
Eeeeeo
Eeeeeo
Eeo Eeo
Eeo Eeo
Ilarilalilalilaaalero
Ilarilalilalilaaalero
All right
All right
This ain't good, Neighbor
Dr. Zomboss has every machine around controlled with his voice.
Now smash his stage!
The concert's oooooover!
I still want to listen a while longer.
You bunch of savages!
My time machine, Penny, is still missing. However, ...
Check out how sturdy our defenses are first.
It's tough enough to withstand any form of assault.
How dare you build such a filthy defense line so close to my concert venue!
You'll be regretted for what you planted. Get prepared for on my secret weapon.

Your defense will vanish like snowflakes!
Dr. Zomboss
Caulipowers hypnotize zombies on your lawn.
Oh no! All the lawnmowers went to Dr. Zomboss' concert!
Dr. Zomboss is just too charming.
Never let zombies get close. We have no lawnmowers available.
By the way, I'm also going to the concert. See you.
The music is stronger. Let's rock!!
The time rifts enabled zombies to form an even larger band.
It might be a must to travel through other timelines and return when we obtain more plants.
To my esteemed enemy.
I commend your ability to build defenses.
Your moat-like defense in the front of your fortress looks...

...as fragile as a piggy bank that shatters at the first blow.
Dr. Zomboss, the valiant
Special air forces detected.
These pilots are really huge.
Getting them airborne doesn't seem easy.
Electrical current detected.
We are approaching the thunderclouds.
Accumulated electrical charge will have negative effects on plants.
If we collect the charge before it accumulates...
...they will provide considerable destructive power.
The composition of Moonbeans:

Cellulose: 1%
Protein: 2%
Water: 5%

Sun: 22%
Dynamite: 70%
Sun Bomb?
It's already midnight.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, we dispatched several plant teams to the vicinity of the zombie air base.
Looks like those zombies anticipated this in advance.
They seem furious about being woken up by us in the midnight...
They've dispatched an elite force to guard the area.
Don't be afraid — our plant teams are all elites too!
Let's take this opportunity to reduce the enemy's forces!
Reach the task and go home!
The battle planes heavily damaged our ship.
Though we've finished repairing,
But I don't think we have the capability to survive from further attack.
About time to bring out my treasured Pineapple, ...
...which can reflect the projectiles from our enemies.
Treasured, huh?
Look at those clouds! They look like...
...clouds.
Speaking of aerial combat, how could there be no guns or bullets?
Next, let's welcome our aerial combat ace...
The Asparagus!
Have fun with them.
The special bullets from Skyshooters create air currents within a small area.
Though it's not strong enough to blow zombies away like Blover does.
However, it can hinder the zombies' movements.
Be confident for their participation.
And, of course, they can fly.
Alert! Enemy Drop Ships detected!
Watch your back.
11,300 meters above sea level
Enemy aircraft at 4,923 meters
No electrical current detected. Looks like we're in luck.
These trained zombies don't seem thirsty for brains.
They're likely aiming at our aerial fortress.
They are not gonna make it.
May we have good luck, Neighbor.
I've deployed a powerful troop on your lawn.
Command them with Escape Root.
By the way, this root is an employee at the logistics station in town.
I've also prepared a few extra troops for you.
Choose one of them to support.
Always make sure not to lose your commander.
Oxygen is lethal for some organisms.
So as shadow power.
The gas released by Noctarine, while powering shadow plants...
...damages contacting zombies as well.
When Murkadamia Nuts are shadow-powered...
...they will grow surrounding and regrowing jelly murk.
This jelly seems like a tough bite.
Shadow power can amplify the projectiles from Shadow Peashooters...
...making them able to penetrate anything.
They'd unleash greater energy with more shadow power around.
Our carts are stuck.
Gloomvines will clear nearby obstacles...
...Meanwhile shadow-powering the plants sharing the same square with them.
Massive shadow power detected.
The enemies are in the light, while we are in the "shadow".
Lurking in the shadows!
Now presenting, my scientific technology...
...combined with the unique Qigong Sect around China.

Qigong Master will teach you what true MANNERS is!
Dr. Zomboss
Data indicates that the source of time-space fluctuations along with more blackholes is already near our lawn.
It seems there won't be a taco on the other side of the blackholes.
So there's no kongfu-fighters left to challenge us!
Time to flee I guess.
Cause I've had enough dumplings.
It's hard to change you taste, User Dave.
Let's go and find tacos in other timelines.
It seems I'd have to cope with our problems on my own...
In most cases, the coefficient of static friction is greater than that of dynamic friction.
What I meant is, ...
...zombies are blow-able when pushed back.
Gumnuts pop sticky gum onto zombies, ...
...pinning them in place and causing them to block other zombies behind them.
Try pushing back those Shield Zombies.
That'll make them turn their shields off.
Stay alert! Shields will absorb all the area effects from the projectiles.
Holly Knight deals damage to zombies attacking him,...
...and can launch 3 prickly barrier leaves to knock back and damage zombies.
Try pushing back those Shield Zombies.
That'll make them turn their shields off.
Stay alert! Shields will absorb all the area effects from the projectiles.
Get covered!
And your probability to survive would be significantly increased.
Good luck, Neighbor!
Pumpkins can be planted on top of other plants to provide a tough additional layer of armor.
Except for supporting our defence, ...
...Strong light burns and blinds the zombies in the eyes.
That really spins and stuns their minds.
Not only do Shine Vines produce sun on their own...
...but boost our producing plants as well.
That'll make those costly plants affordable for us sooner.
It's, SHHHHINING!
We're arriving where the Enlighten-Famlily plants are located.
Enlightening? I see nothing but darkness.
Do NOT stare at light sources, User Dave!
Atomic Bombegranates explode on contact, dealing heavy damages in a huge area and spawning Seedlings around them.
However they are spawned as Seedlings.
These zombies are getting tricky!
They just always suddenly appear in the middle of our lawn.
Just defeat them and all their friends!
Friends of our enemies aren't always our enemies too, User Dave.
Zombies are easy to be persuaded to fight for us.
If that's not easy enough...
...just keep them frozen and make them 'right'!
This is a time-limited mission.
And that literally means our time is limited.
Hurry up and win in time!
Well wasn't that easy?
It seems we've managed to appease the magic deep in the forest.
Defeating me using my scientific achievements?
It seems you are even more tricky than I am.
Meet the combination of the forest magic and the 19th-century tech!
—— Thunder Traps ——
Everyone knows that gold is perfect as conductor.
Oh wait... Why am I telling you how they work?
As clarification, I am not so foolish that I'd make my Zombot Aerostatic Gondola 2.0 with gold.
Not Again! Our lawnmowers are non-mowers!
Data indicates that our mowers have magic opposite to that in the forests, User Dave.
But as known to all, opposites attract one another.
Denser jungles! And more treasure-hunting teams.
It seems the magic from the shadowy jungle has granted the zombies even greater power.
It might be a must to travel through other timelines and return when we obtain more plants.
Those swinging 3-section staffs are really annoying!
I'm sure there's no way they could reflect fluid.
Good news is Cantaloup-pults can provide fluid attacks.
Keep cautious. We can only provide two of them for now.
The storm is gone.
There's no reason to stay here any longer.
Time to move.
Our loot this time is perfect!
No need to worry about taco preservation any more!
Vamporcinis drain blood from nearby zombies, making themselves tougher.
Umbrella Leaves respond to zombies with falling actions nearby.
It's not a good idea to let Chicken Wranglers get close to the flowers with their chickens.
Are those chickens enjoying zombie jam?
Is that a dream?
My smelt somethin' tasty!
I think that's from Sweet Potatos.
Their smell will attract nearby zombies and gather them around.
I found a path that leads deeper in the rift.
There is another plant.
It's like a...
...a hot potato that is hot enough to burn!
Hotdates not only attracts nearby zombies...
...but also burn the hole lane when defeated.
Chicken Wranglers won't release chickens when frozen or stunned.
Hey, neighbor!
Fire!
I said FIRE!
Strawbursts have three growth phases.
As they grow through their growth phases, its damages increases.
But sometimes you don't need them to be completely grown.
Conjecture verified.
A new plant has been added to our collection.
But I don't see my tacos nowhere!
It's time to leave.
Keep time-traveling and reveal other time-space rifts.
MY TACOS...
The zombies' attack in the rift is much harder than any other timelines.
No matter when a rift appears...
...It's always a better choice to return where we came from.
Until we obtain more plants.
What time is it?
I can't calculate the accurate time, User Dave.
We are trapped in a rift...
It's a place without time, but more chaotic than any other timelines.
That means zombies from all timelines will converge...
...and forming attacks towards us, even fiecer than any other timelines.
Is there a taco?
Unfortunately, my taco detector found nothing.
However, I've detected new plants that might be acquired after we completely explore the rift.
Let's go find those tacos!
Are we still in Ancient Egypt?
We do absolutely remain in Ancient Egypt.
However, time-space fluctuations detected.
We'll drop into unknown timelines if we stay here too long.
We have to stop the storm!
Luckily Solar Tomatoes fits in this job.
Focus on the frozen wind before the storms.
Looks like it's out of Barrel Rollers here.
Stay cautious!
We must leave before the next storm arrives.
Seems that Solar Tomatoes don't make sun on their own.
In face, Solar Tomatoes convert zombies' energy into sun.
Additionally, affected zombies will be temporarily stunned.
Solar Tomatoes stun zombies, each of which produces a sun.
Different kinds of slow-down effects can be multiplied with each other simultaneously.
Deploy different plants with slow-down abilities and slow zombies down furthermore.
Sap-flings can slow down groups of zombies in the same tile.
If you stare at the sun, the ground will become darker!
When a Plantern is bright enough, zombies will ignore all near by plants.
Feeding them Plant Food will make them uncommonly bright!
Zombies illuminated by Planterns will carry sun.
Use these sun to build your defense!
Those wizards developed potions that allow zombies to hide themselves in darkness.
No worries! We've got light sources to reveal their covers!
Do you know Blovers can blow away those zombies off the ground?
Fortunatly, Parsnips can toss'em up in the air.
Let's utilize this to handle those armored sea monsters!
Remember, Spikerocks can be healed with First Aid.
I've found Parsnips.
They act like crabs but charge towards zombies like Guacodiles.
But it seems that they hate swimming.
Land crabs!
It's extemely cold here.
Data indicates that cold-air outbreak from paleolithic time had striked on this area.
Anything for us to keep ourselves warm?
I see a huuuuuuge herd of dinosaurs!
It's time to send them back where they came from.
Early worms get eaten by birds.
It's true both for defense and attack.
Meteor Flowers can frighten away those annoying prehistoric creatures.
I didn't know that dinosaurs can see their future.
The storm is rising.
We need to leave immediately.
The sandstorm is pushing something dangerous onto our lawn!
What about just freezing the sandstorm and stop'em?
We've got a Celery Stalker here.
I'll put this little guy onto the minecart.
I'll remove it with a shovel instead.
Is that all the Ice-shrooms?
Unfortunately, I'm not able to find another Ice-shroom in such a short time.
Seems there's gonna be a fierce battle.
Rough beginning.
Rougher proceeding.
Roughest ending!
I've detected mushrooms that can freeze all over our lawn.
Does that mean I've got a larger space for taco storage?
We still need to time-travel for another 4,516,783 times to get such quantity of tacos, User Dave.
Gosh! Your lawn seems 100 times messier than my farming warehouse!
Two persistent routes for zombies detected.
Unobstructed enough for them!

Alert:
Strong time-space warp detected.
Is that a good news?
No extra time-space warp detected.
About time we exit this rift
Is that a bad news?
Autumn is perfect for outdoor activities, isn't it?
Agreed.
It's delightful not worrying about heating problems on my computer.
Oh, you heard that skitter-scattery sound?

Alert:
It seems that zombies are also hanging out to enjoy Autumn.
What? We're out of Moonflowers?
Indeed.
However, do not forget Gloom-shrooms transmit shadow power between each other.
Seems that zombies are holding an underwater pool party.
Shall we join them?
Protect the three Gloom-shrooms at all costs.
They are necessary for us to step over this rift.
Ever seen the moon shining in daytime?
If not……
Today's your lucky day.
Look! Another mushroom that can be powered by Moonflowers!
Gloomshrooms poison zombies when powered.
Furthermore, those poisonous spores carry shadow power.
Sharing is caring!
Alert: A huge wave of zombies underwater detected.
Oh no! I was just considering taking a swim down here!
We cannot lose extra plants.
Always make sure that at least one Ghost Pepper finally remains.
As ghosts, Ghost Peppers always levitate in the air.
You smelt something?
It smells like...
Doom!
What are we waiting for? Let's blow these zombies up in one shot!
Better choice to wait until a great number of zombies gather.
Keep an eye on the safety of other plants on your lawn.
The beach here lacks viable conditions for planting.
We must wait for window periods for mushroom deployment.
Save those remaining Lily Pads for extreme emergencies.

Red Alert:
An unquantifiable number of Gargantuars are approaching!

Green "Alert":
We've just received support from SUPER mushrooms!
Let's tear up the entire lawn!
Buttercups hurl butter at the zombies who tried eating them.
You bet! They're not common cups.
They're Butter-cups!
Blooming Hearts' projectiles gradually reduce zombies' defense.
Maybe that's because they're packed with love?
Actually, just because her shots deliver toxins.
Torchwoods are super handy.
First of all… they're literally the “Torch” woods!
Watch out for the jesters hiding among the zombies.
They'll totally mess things up if they catch your ignited peas!
Ignite the Marigolds and blow those zombies up!
Those Wall-nuts will be thankful for that.
Orange Marigolds blow up when they die.
Also, watch out for the Mega Gatling Pea with unstable temper.
Torchwoods can light up peas passing by.
But sometimes triggering them up among zombies is also a good call.
Don't you worry'bout them.
They're willing to do that.
Whoa, the plants here seem to have formed into groups.
Sort of like... Jack and Mary.
They used to be the hottest combo.
But by now they've become significantly weak.
I wasn't talking about Jack and Mary.
I think we've finished exploring this rift.
Is that all the plants from the Appease Family?
Actually, plants from one family don't gather merely in one place.
Let's roll towards Appease Family - Part II!
Maybe we can use Qigong Abbot's ability to push the Red Stingers into the safe zone.
Ideally, we should push them behind the gold tiles.
Charge into battle, little cuties!
Maybe we can use Qigong Abbot's ability to push the Red Stingers into the safe zone.
Ideally, we should push them behind the gold tiles.
Charge into battle, little cuties!
These tombstones engraved with pictograms really freak me out.
Hey, on witnessing Dandelions' fluffy hair! Who can resist to……
Blow it all away!
Please restrain such impulses.
It'll make those Dandelions passive for a while.
Pea Vines boost all peashooters and plants from Appease Family.
Sometimes even affecting those which are not even peas.
Seems there's gonna be more than one type of plants here.
Plants with similar characteristics tend to co-occur.
We'll see more such situations in the future.
Pumpkins protect the plants inside them, but they can't protect other plants on the lawn.
That's just too unfair for plants without Pumpkins!
According to my data, User Dave wants to protect more plants in a short time.
Luckily Bamboozles are perfectly suit for such situation.
They can launch bamboo buskets to five locations on your lawn.
Whoa! That's a young abbot!
They must be extraordinarily powerful leading Kongfu Temples at this age.
I've detected special energy flowing through their entire beings.
It's confirmed that they are masters of Qigong.
Solar Sages' meditation has reached their peak.
They could illuminate the undead in a heartbeat.
We've got a serious problem.
Abbot Zombies from other Kongfu Temples are converging onto our lawn.
It seems that we're inadvertently challenging all Kongfu Temples in China.
I'm gonna reach the PEAK of KONGFU!
Bad news for you.

Devil of Dynamite wasn't the only alliance I've been cooperating with.
Dr. Zomboss
Get prepared. An enemy with unparalleled skill is on his way.
I've been ready to take him down since the day I was born!
I can't believe we actually defeated that legendarily strong enemy!
We have to celebrate such victory with a feast!
We've got little time for this, User Dave.
Kongfu Zombies' attack is still far from over.
How surprising! Blade Wielding Hero was defeated.
Even have I started to appreciate your strengths...
...in your dreams.
Rumours said that Lychee and Heavenly Peach are in couple!
Though they were just probably standing too close while blocking of the zombies.
In fact, they don't even know each others' names.
Lychees take damages and scatter fragments of their shells in an area.
Additionally, their shells will burst out on burnt by torches.
I can't believe you're still bumbling between timelines with that inefficient and ridiculous machine!
Have you ever thought about trying new technologies?
Our new time-traveling technology is nearly complete.

See that? We've just done some tests on your lawn.
Dr. Zomboss
More statues!!!
Is that the result of your trials?
These statues with Bronzes sealed in them seem different.
Get prepared for new types of Bronzes.
Warning! Massive astronomical object detected!
Better get off the planet before it gets torn apart!
False alarm, User Dave. Gravitational fluctuations in this area affected my sensors.
Gravitational fluctuations?
The Power Lilies contain the similar type of energy to Taichi tiles.
This energy can help us generate more Plant Foods.
Did Power Lilies absorb energies from the tiles?
Or did the energy in the tiles feed Power Lilies?
Heavenly Peaches heal injured plants. They emit spiritual energy and create protective shields.
Which can make plants temporarily invincible.
We have attracted the attention of Monk zombies in Kongfu Temple.
Compared to the Kongfu Zombies, they possess superior physical prowess and more refined combat skills.
I can't wait until witnessing a true Kungfu contest!
Good weather today. Right, time travelers?
Perhaps now is a good time to hold a feast somewhere with a good scenery.
Perfect timing to introduce my new friend! He's a true hero who can drink a thousand cups without getting drunk!

Of course, no need to purposely look for a site! Your lawn is a perfect one!
Dr. Zomboss
High-energy reaction detected!
It appears our actions here have attracted a rather formidable opponent.
I heard fireworks! Has the feast begun?
I don't think that was fireworks.
Better get ourselves covered.
It's gone quiet. Is it all clear to come out of the bunker?
We just beat the greatest enemy in Kongfu Temple.
And what'bout our feast?!
We must prepare for a stronger assault immediately.
And no time for a feast.
What a surprise that you managed to defeat that devil!
But this is not the end of our battle.
We'll have our day sooner or later.
The Latest, and the last GIFT for you!
It's composed from the Mega-Minds of two genius.

I'd prepare another GIFT for you if you guys don't hate it enough this time.
Dr. Zomboss
I thought he had a good memory! He clearly said it was the last one.
Well, I suppose that's what one would get for time-traveling...
And now I couldn't see the other side of the lawn.
There're special energies rolling among those statues.

There is a 93.7% probability that Bronzes specializing in Qigong, is sealed within.
Margin of error: 1.3%.
A GIFT for y'all, time travelers!
These statues are really striking, aren't they?
It took me and my new mate tremendous efforts to bring them here. Hope you'd like'em.

No, no, no. Hope you'd hate'em.
Dr. Zomboss
These are really tall statues. Who do they depict?
According to my data, powerful Bronze warriors are sealed within these stone statues.
And what's more, these statues are highly unstable!
Resistant Radish are deep-rooted plants.
It makes them utterly un-movable facing any external force.
Bamboo Shoots are skilled to dig beneath the zombies.
It makes them ignored by most zombies.
No wonder these little guys keep themselves short.
I heard drums and gongs!
That refers to a Kongfu Competition going on.
I think I can get a high rank.
You wouldn't be willing to participate in the zombies' Kongfu Competition.
There's only a three-meter-long chopping board left for us to sit on.
I could smell dynamite.
Don't let the zombies trigger the barrels of dynamite.
That's not the scenario we want to see.
Also, is it true that Bloomerangs never miss a catch?
I just saw A zombie flew-by, somehow...
The rockets on Rocket Imps's back push them towards our defenses rapidly.
These annoying Imps won't stop until they collide into something.
They're going one way, like a taco to my belly!
There are heat and fire entrenched in Fire Gourds' stomachs.
Seems that they're in high spirits right now!
Tap on Fire Gourds so that they will breathe out the fire.
The further they charge, the farther they breathe.
Let's burn the zombies and all those wooden racks on the lawn down!
We have arrived in 17th-century of China. All the zombies here are equipped with unique skills.
Can we find out the secrets of Fortune Cookies here?
Fortune Cookies are not from China, User Dave...
Whoa! There's a weird pattern on the lawn!
The data indicates that the Tai-Chi tile contains quantities of energy.
Maybe our plants could bring that energy out with there roots!
Myn olde foo, long yseyne.
Hast thou encounter'd the stronger strain of walking dead, the foul pestilence that doth wax in might?
Verily, these are useless trifles!
But that which thou must face, shall here end thy foolish quest!
We did it? Right, Penny?
Ideed. User Dave. Mission accomplished.
Quest completed. It's time to travel through other timelines.
Tis time to shape a new counsail, by my troth!
There'd be up to five chompers in total on your lawn and in the conveyor every moment.
Seems that terrible quantities of gravestones are rising.
It is likely that we're going to confront stronger zombie variants soon.
Including those buried under the gravestones...
It might be a must to travel through other timelines and return when we obtain more plants.
You must have just witnessed my upgraded motor surfer zombies already.
Now you're about to confront my even greater masterpiece: Zombot Sharktronic Sub 2.0!
What a suffer.
Seems like this timeline has come to an end.
This can't have happened!
Guacodiles knock back zombies on contact.
Now knock back zombies that are close to your house back into where they came from with Guacodiles!
You heard that? Weird roars came from the far water.
Waves of zombies diving underwater detected.
It'd not be a good idea to play in the water here.
Better go to other timelines 'til our plant alliance becomes stronger.
Those peashooters are confused and are just going to be in the way.
Use the shovel to dig them up and make room for useful plants!
Hey neighbor!
Can I borrow that hot sauce?
I've been holding onto this taco for forever!
Oh! That was...AMAZING!
I want to eat THAT taco again! I need my TIME MACHINE!
Her name is Penny and I'm Crazy Dave. But you can call me Crazy Dave.
Finally, another User who can process my queries.
Let me postulate, Dave wants to go back in time to eat his taco... again...
She's so smart! Now let's go after my taco!
Those plants look hungry.
If only there was something that you could feed them.
Plant Food is packed with vitamins and minerals.
It's an essential part of a complete breakfast.
I wonder if Plant Food works on other types of plants?
Aww...you let your plant get eaten! Try again!
I love the smell of coconut cannons in the morning!
Smells like... well, coconuts.
It appears the zombies have been gathered in that corral.
A not O.K. Corral!
Better plant something before they get loose.
Oh good. There are no zombies here.
False. They're using camouflage.
You mean they're usin... camel-flage.
Tap 'Find More' to see where you can find more seed packets for each plant.
You've got a new plant!
But are you familiar with the usage of your new plant?
That's what the almanac is for!
Click on that icon and let's find out.
You know what would be helpful?
A place where you can read about plants and zombies.
You mean like the interactive Almanac?
Nah, that would never work.
Take those seed packets you won and upgrade your Peashooter!
User Dave. Please note the line of Banana Launchers.
They appear to need our protection!
Let's get to it! After all, bananas are a very a-PEELING fruit!
User Dave, if I had a head, I would be shaking it right now.
My research indicates that the sport of bowling experienced a heyday during this era.
Are you thinking what I'm thinking, Penny?
I find your thought process indecipherable, User Dave.
I was thinking that Bowling Bulbs would make excellent allies here.
Huh. I was thinking how much I love wearing bowling shoes.
So many colors ... right there on my feet!
When fighting zombies from the deep...
...we need a plant with the appetite of a shark.
I catch your drift, Penny. You're talking about Chomper!
Indeed. His sharp teeth could turn the tide of battle.
Hey, I have an idea too! We could call this Chomper Week!
If we must, User Dave. If we must.
Look at this beeeeautiful beach!
It's got everything a growing plant needs!
Sun, sand and lots o' water!
Caution, User Dave. My sensors indicate there are zombies on your beach...
... and far too much water. It will overwhelm the plants.
No problem-o! We'll just lay down some Lily Pads.
Then the other plants can ride the waves!
Or as the vernacular of this era goes: They can "hang ten".
Right on, Penny. Right on!
Listen up, dudes! I'm here to totally bum you out.
Way down deep, there's a certain creep...
When he swims up, your brains he'll keep!
Later losers! Doc Zomboss
That dude is totally gnarly.
He is also quite unpleasant, User Dave. Quite unpleasant.
Dudes, like, you're totally in for it now!
The Deep Sea Gargantuars have their slimy sights on you.
You can run! You can swim!
But you can't escape their scaly grip!
